signals.title: JPY/SEK — G10 Bilateral Theme + Monetary Divergence
signals.text: JPY 1W avg outperformance of +1.916% across 7 pairs against SEK laggard status of -1.624% creates a 3.540% bilateral spread favoring JPY upside. BoJ holds at 1.0%. The Tokyo open and the upcoming BoJ meeting on 18 Sep resolve this divergent divergence. Trade bias: Bullish JPY/SEK into the open; SEK underperformance accelerates the trend. Catalyst: Sydney/Tokyo open followed by the BoJ meeting on 18 Sep. Risk: BoJ leaves the policy rate unchanged at 1.0% with dovish forward guidance.

signals.title: USD/CAD — Strait of Hormuz Drone Strike + Trendline Resistance
signals.text: CAD COT leveraged funds net short -70.1k (pctl 10%, z=-1.44) faces geopolitical headline pressure after Iran launched drones toward ships in the Strait of Hormuz, testing WTI crude at $100.30/bbl. USD/CAD closed Friday at 1.3872 after stalling against major technical trendline resistance, while Canada's strong ESI at +25.6 buffers CAD against broader USD strength. Geopolitical escalation into the Asian open determines whether crude supply disruptions force a CAD rebound and squeeze stretched spec shorts. Trade bias: Bearish USD/CAD into the open; crude spike threatens technical resistance. Catalyst: Sydney open crude oil reopening following Strait of Hormuz conflict headlines. Risk: De-escalation headlines emerge over the weekend and WTI breaks below $98.00/bbl.
evidence: WTI Oil: $100.3/bbl following Middle East drone attacks
USD/CAD Friday close: 1.3872 stalling at trendline resistance

signals.title: AUD/USD — Crowded Speculative Long Unwind Risk
signals.text: AUD COT leveraged funds net long +50.3k (73.5% long, pctl 94%, z=+1.79) creates crowded-long liquidation risk after AUD/USD closed Friday at 0.7173. The RBA hold at 4.35% and positive AONIA-over-SOFR carry of +71bp provide support, but elevated positioning leaves the currency fragile to US Dollar rebound dynamics ahead of the FOMC. The Sydney open is the catalyst that tests leveraged fund conviction around the 0.7164 20-day SMA. Trade bias: Bearish AUD/USD on rallies; stretched spec long overhang limits upside. Catalyst: Sydney market open and liquidity resumption. Risk: Australian economic outperformance drives AUD/USD clear above the 0.7220 resistance zone.
evidence: AUD COT LF net: +50,250 (long% 73.5%, pctl 94%, z=+1.79)

signals.title: GBP/USD — Heavy Leveraged Long Overhang Ahead of BoE
signals.text: GBP COT leveraged funds net long +47.5k (71.6% long, pctl 93%, z=+1.27) exposes GBP/USD to long-liquidation pressure following Friday's close at 1.3527. The Bank of England meeting on 17 Sep approaches with policy on hold at 3.75% while the SONIA-SOFR carry premium sits flat at just +9bp. The BoE rate decision on 17 Sep is the catalyst that determines if crowded long positions can withstand FOMC tightening risks. Trade bias: Bearish GBP/USD into early-week sessions; crowded positioning caps continuation. Catalyst: BoE meeting on 17 Sep. Risk: BoE delivers a hawkish rate vote split indicating additional tightening requirements.
